title: onkerma rigida
intro: Onkerma rigida, commonly known as a type of shrub native to South Africa, belongs to the family Fabaceae and is also referred to as the "tree marigold" or "wild marigold". The Onkerma rigida plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in treating wounds and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Onkerma rigida include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Onkerma rigida include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
